sources.label: App patches by Dudek, for use with Morphe.
sources.author: Dudek
patch_list: Shortens the action button's local progress feedback from 0.3 to 0.125 seconds.
Reveals dialogue text at 100 characters per second. Dialogue choices and manual advancement remain available.
Speeds up the brief pause and fade in the action-button completion animation.
Shortens the pauses after focus minigames and lesson banners while keeping earned grades and lesson progress.
Hides the paid greeting and two verified automatic starter offers. The shop and manually opened offers remain available.
Makes normal interactions cost zero energy while preserving their action progress.
Shortens avatar preview camera transitions when changing clothing categories or slots.
Shortens three pauses in the reward reveal screen while keeping the original reward and collection flow.
Experimental. Finishes the local countdown for an already eligible quest through its normal expiry path. Objective cooldowns and event schedules still apply.
